criterion: Text Fit & Wrap: long content / overflow
description: In the Data room agent side panel, my first, long user message rendered as a bubble about one character wide, so the text stacks one letter per line in a tall orange strip. A later, shorter message rendered normally. It stayed broken after a viewport resize.
expected: The user bubble wraps at word boundaries within the panel width, like the second message.
actual: Bubble width collapses to about 30px; letters stacked vertically (see step-3.png, step-4.png, step-7-after-resize.png). It may only happen for the first message sent right after the panel opens, I did not isolate the trigger.
suggested_fix: Give the user message bubble a min-width or max-width relative to the panel and verify the panel's container width when the first message is optimistically rendered.
